integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained from the stated operator conditions. Finite transfer-matrix computations are corroborative only. Source date was checked against the arXiv v1 timestamp, and the primary mathematical-physics ownership was checked against indexed MSC metadata listing 81Q35 first for the bibliographic record used in this research workflow.
scientific_limitations: Identical positive delta strengths on a one-dimensional loop with periodic boundary conditions; ground state only. No claim for unequal couplings, magnetic twists, excited states, higher-dimensional point interactions, or quantitative stability.
title: All-coupling equidistant maximizer for repulsive point interactions on a loop
